prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity mobile web section design comp, portrait 390 x 844, no phone frame
Primary request: redesign only the mobile section titled ‘Un arreglo que empieza contigo.’ for an elegant online florist selling handmade pipe-cleaner flowers in Guatemala. This section is a compact teaser for a future dedicated personalized-arrangements page, not a full pricing or information page.
Input images: Image 1 is the real Tier 1 product photograph; Image 2 is the real Tier 2 product photograph; Image 3 is the real Tier 3 product photograph. Preserve the products and handmade chenille texture faithfully; use each photograph once.
Visual system: refined contemporary florist editorial. Matte blush background #e8d1cc, deep wine typography #641326, charcoal secondary text #5d4b4f, cream #faf2eb. Square corners only. High-contrast Didone serif for headlines and tier names, restrained modern sans-serif for labels, body, and CTA. No cards, no rounded corners, no gradients, no drop shadows.
Composition: Show a single compact section that fits almost completely in one mobile viewport. Start with a large elegant wine headline on 3 lines: ‘Un arreglo que / empieza / contigo.’ Under it, a short sans-serif sentence: ‘Tres niveles para darle forma a una idea, contigo.’ Then create the signature visual: an editorial three-panel photographic triptych, edge-to-edge inside the page gutter, around 270px tall. All three tiers are visible at once. The middle Tier 2 panel is wider and slightly taller; the side panels are narrow vertical crops. Use thin wine hairlines between panels. Do not overlap rounded floating cards. Let the flowers feel abundant and tactile.
Tier labeling: directly below the triptych, one horizontal ruled index with three compact equal columns. Exact labels: ‘01 Un gesto’, ‘02 Una ocasión’, ‘03 Una historia’. Add tiny uppercase meta ‘TIER 1’, ‘TIER 2’, ‘TIER 3’ beneath or aligned beside each respective name. Keep this readable and elegant, not dense.
CTA: finish with one understated text link on blush, deep wine, exact text ‘Conocer los arreglos personalizados’ followed by a fine right arrow. No filled button.
Spacing: generous enough to feel refined but intentionally compact, about 760–820px total section height. Mobile-first hierarchy, strong photographic focal moment, no extraneous navigation or footer.
Constraints: Spanish text must appear exactly as specified; realistic web UI, production-feasible; no prices, no testimonials, no badges, no invented claims, no contact form, no extra decorative illustrations, no logos, no watermark.
